# Tunnel Whitespace

> Tunnel Whitespace is a free screening map of tunnel car wash supply against population for every census tract in the United States. It compares the people living within about a 10-minute drive of each tract with the 11,854 operating tunnel car washes (express, full-serve and flex) and 347 reported in development, and shows where population could support more tunnels.

Built by Anthony Warren (First Vice President, Car Washes, Southeast, Matthews Real Estate Investment Services). Population: Esri 2024 estimates. Tunnel car wash locations verified October 2026. Updated October 29, 2026. Screening estimates for research, not investment advice. Cite as: Tunnel Whitespace, tunnelwhitespace.com.

## Pages

- [U.S. map](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/): interactive map (requires JavaScript)
- [Southeast map](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/southeast/): NC, SC, GA, VA, TN, FL and AL
- [Top 100 U.S. metros](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/markets/): ranking table at one tunnel per 20,000 people
- [Southeast metros](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/markets/southeast/): all 182 metro and micro areas touching NC, SC, GA, VA, TN, FL, AL, ranked, with tunnel counts by state
- [Northeast and Mid-Atlantic metros](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/markets/northeast/): all 119 metro and micro areas based in ME, NH, VT, MA, RI, CT, NY, NJ, PA, DE, MD, DC, WV, ranked, with tunnel counts by state
- [Midwest metros](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/markets/midwest/): all 284 metro and micro areas based in OH, MI, IN, IL, WI, MN, IA, MO, KS, NE, SD, ND, ranked, with tunnel counts by state
- [South Central metros](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/markets/south-central/): all 166 metro and micro areas based in TX, OK, AR, LA, MS, KY, ranked, with tunnel counts by state
- [Mountain West metros](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/markets/mountain-west/): all 93 metro and micro areas based in AZ, NM, CO, UT, NV, ID, MT, WY, ranked, with tunnel counts by state
- [Pacific metros](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/markets/pacific/): all 83 metro and micro areas based in CA, OR, WA, AK, HI, ranked, with tunnel counts by state
- [Method, sources and FAQ](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/about/): how the gap is calculated and what the map does not show

## Optional

- [Full text for language models](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/llms-full.txt): method, FAQ, tunnel counts by state and the ranking tables in one Markdown file
- [Interactive map (ArcGIS)](https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/6101a0eeeaf14029bf49495ef8baab85/): requires JavaScript
